annotations.text:
One thing to decide.

The twelve-stop book at the foot of Main is the only part still hard-coded. Keep it as the trip's own book with a denominator to fill, or drop it and let the page be nothing but what is near you and what you have?

Drawn here as kept.
The band is one card in one place. It is absent entirely when nothing is within reach, so the page does not carry a permanent empty slot.
This board is the argument, not a screen. The four blocks are the decisions I need you to agree with before any of it is built.
